required_event_evidence: permanent issuer/security identity and fiscal period
release timestamp with timezone and primary-source evidence, or a documented conservative availability bound for a daily study; filing acceptance is a different timestamp
actual EPS and pre-release consensus on matching accounting, currency, quarter-vs-YTD duration and share/split basis
documented consensus vintage available strictly before release; current download time is not historical availability
actual EPS version available before the intended decision; exclude later revisions from earlier decisions
raw-source SHA256, immutable filing accession or vendor version identifier and retrieval timestamps
required_universe_evidence: historical eligibility including delisted names, not current survivors
market beta estimated from aligned pre-event stock and market returns; no post-event beta and no ADR substitution
point-in-time sectors, size/liquidity and corporate actions; no exclusion using later outcomes
research_comparators: matched high-beta universe without the earnings selection
ordinary price momentum as a separate comparator
unlevered passive market exposure with dividends
design_requirements: freeze sample dates, thresholds, holding period, primary statistic and costs before outcome inspection
separate analyst surprise, seasonal time-series SUE and announcement-return momentum
report recent eras, non-microcap and microcap samples separately; do not promote whichever subgroup wins
separate overlapping event studies from cash-funded account returns and handle issuer/date dependence
measure costs and executable entry/exit assumptions; never include the pre-entry announcement jump
report win rate, payoff distribution, drawdown, exposure and concentration; high beta does not imply high win rate
